evidence.note: Bury's prefatory note calls Letter XII certainly spurious and connects it with pseudo-Pythagorean Ocellus material.
The Stanford Encyclopedia discussion of Archytas identifies the Twelfth Letter as pseudo-Platonic in connection with a spurious Archytan letter.
The Twelfth Letter is uniquely followed in the manuscript tradition by an explicit denial of Platonic authorship.

rationale: The Twelfth Letter is exceptionally weak as a claim to Platonic authorship. Its manuscript tradition itself preserves an explicit authenticity denial, Bury treats it as certainly spurious and links it to pseudo-Pythagorean forgery, and modern scholarship continues to identify it as pseudo-Platonic. D is therefore appropriate while retaining the text in the historical attribution catalog.
